thread:
Sam C: Quick heads-up — CumulusPay asked for a 4-week POC to validate realtime txn summarization + entity extraction. Can we align on minimal scope and success criteria?
Jordan L: Thanks — major asks I heard: low-latency summaries (<= 200ms p50), accurate PII redaction, and merchant/entity extraction into JSON.
Aliya P: Adding: they want an endpoint that ingests streaming txn text and returns structured JSON + summary. Prefer streaming responses if possible.
Mike R: Sounds doable. Proposed MVP endpoints: `/ingest/stream` (streaming), `/ingest/batch` (bulk), `/eval/metrics` (reporting).
Rachel S: For success criteria we should split infra + quality:
- infra: 99.9% uptime during business hours, p50 latency <= 200ms, p95 <= 450ms
- quality: summary ROUGE-L >= 0.65 (on their 100-sample set), entity F1 >= 0.9
Sam C: @Jordan can you confirm those QA thresholds with their technical lead? Also pricing question: they asked if Dedicated pool is required for the latency SLO or if hosted with reserved capacity suffices.
Jordan L: I asked Ops — Dedicated gives predictable p95 but hosted with 1.5x reserved throughput + KV cache might be okay. I'll get a concrete cost delta.
Aliya P: Security blockers: they require KMS integration, audit logs export, and EU data residency. Also a short SCCQ for their InfoSec. Rachel, can you own the SCCQ answers?
Rachel S: Yes — I started the SCCQ draft. Current blockers: 1) KMS key wrap details, 2) SOC2 export for last 12 months, 3) network egress IP list for VPC peering.
Olivia: For prompts/evals — request from customer: 200 golden prompts covering refunds, disputes, and chargebacks. We need to map those to eval rubric. Suggesting 3 buckets: correctness, brevity, and safety/PII handling.
Mike R: Suggest concrete prompt template for summary: `Summarize the transaction for a customer service rep in 1-2 sentences. Redact any sensitive info. Return JSON: {summary:..., entities:[{type, value, start, end}]}`
Sam C: Love that. Timeline proposal: week 0 (kickoff + security clearance), week 1 (integration + small throughput test), week 2 (eval run w/ 200 prompts), week 3 (latency tuning + reliability), week 4 (handoff + metrics review).
Jordan L: Customer ready to start next Tuesday if we can finalize scope today.
Aliya P: Risks: 1) KV cache miss patterns for short sessions hurting latency, 2) model regression on chargebacks (needs prompt engineering), 3) EU region capacity constraints.
Rachel S: Mitigations: autoscale buffer + canary rollout to EU region, hold a short prompt tuning session with their SME during week 1.
Sam C: Action items: Jordan confirm pricing delta for Dedicated vs hosted reserved by EOD; Rachel finish SCCQ draft; Mike prepare sample integration snippets and the prompt templates; Aliya draft the minimal endpoint contract for engineering.
Jordan L: On it — pinging finance for cost numbers. /cc @deploy-bot for any required infra tickets.
deploy-bot: Created INC-4921: "CumulusPay POC - EU capacity request" (assigned to eng-infra).
Olivia: Quick question on eval metrics export format — do we send CSV or a JSON report? Customer prefers JSON with per-prompt scores.
Mike R: We'll provide both but JSON is primary. Format suggestion: `[{prompt_id, summary_score, entities_f1, pii_flagged}]`.
Sam C: Great. If nobody objects I'll confirm scope with CumulusPay after Rachel's SCCQ update.
Jordan L: No objections from me.
Aliya P: Fine by me.
Rachel S: SCCQ draft done, uploading to the sales drive and linking to the thread now: https://drive.internal/reports/cumulus-sccq-draft
Sam C: Perfect — tagging this for tomorrow's handshake call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
